title: VTOL ferry crawl: stale AI forward speed in the body integrator (2026-11-10)

facts.title: Bot VTOL ferry crawl/overspeed = stale AI forward-speed target comp+0x98 added to the stick flight velocity
facts.fact: The body integrator sub_002AD940 (reached from the comp step sub_002AEC20 when comp+0x140 == 0) stores the body velocity (state comp+0x40, SetVel 0x2B2810 at 0x2ADAB9) as slot5(dt) + the flight model velocity comp+0x10C. slot5 = comp vt+0x14 sub_192A72 -> sub_176A4E -> sub_002AD800, which (with comp+0x144 bit 8 set, as on every flying VTOL) returns heading(yaw, sub_002AD120) x a ground speed: sub_002ACCA0 ramps the current speed comp+0x5C (state +0x40 slot +0x18 = [+0x1C]) toward the target comp+0x98 (state +0x7C [+0x1C], written by SetForwardSpeed sub_002AD5C0 = pct x comp+0xBC x 0.01, clamped to +-comp+0xC0) at comp+0xC4 per second. An AI MoveTo (bot body_moveto) sets comp+0x98; the human/stick flight model never clears it. Fix (v26-vtol b91f768): vtol_stick_take zeroes the target through sub_2AD5C0 whenever the stick takes the craft.
facts.how_to_use: [C7] stickspeed0 zeroed; switch StickSpeed0 / RECOMP_BOT_VTOL_STICK_SPEED0 (default on, 0 = old behaviour). botrec: g('comp',0x98,'f') and g('comp',0x5C,'f') on the craft; [BOT-VTOL] stick takes . (RECOMP_BOT_DIAG).

facts.title: Proof of the VTOL forward-speed fix: recording state and live NRC/Bogged Down CTF runs
facts.fact: Recording 2026-11-10 bot 3 (red ferry): 815 of 857 frames from 12.04 s are stick-flown (branch S, comp+0x144 bit0 clear) with comp+0x98 = -53.4, so vtol_stick_take fires from 12.04 s and the integrator term ramps to 0 within 0.8 s (70 m/s^2). Live (exe v13-v26vtol-f1/f2): NRC CTF red ferry with rider reached the enemy flag in 3 of 3 runs (vtf1 50.9 s, vtf2 58 s, vtf3 32 s then captured), flying 50-68 m/s in clear air; blue ferries 53-59 m/s instead of 90-117. Bogged Down CTF (vtbd1): no crawl_s, ferries 40-52 m/s, blue captured. A/B with StickSpeed0=0 (vtoff1): ferry frames with current ground speed <= -15 had body 36 m/s vs flight model 55; with +45 body 98 vs 39.

facts.title: EdgeStickOut: VtolEdgeAll recovery no longer MoveTo-fights a stick that already flies out of the edge band
facts.fact: vt_edge_recover (called at the end of every VTOL control tick) ran body_moveto toward a point 32 m inside whenever the craft was within 24 m of out-of-bounds, in the same tick the stick (vtol_manual) flew it, so AI and stick frames alternated and neither kept a velocity: the red ferry hung 15-30 s at 0-2 m/s over NRC's base (it lies in the band) with the stick full forward (v26 runs vtf1 t=16-34, vtf2 t=13-43). Now it returns when this tick's forward stick (axis 4 > 0.3) points the nose inward (edge distance 24 m ahead > here + 2).

facts.title: xbox_WatchArmVa: arm the guest write watch at run time (RECOMP_TEST_VTOL_VELWATCH)
facts.fact: xbox_WatchArmVa(va, n) (kit/source/game/src/kernel/xbox_memory_layout.c) moves the page-protect write watch to a guest address at run time and reports every write covering that dword (value, esp, host RIP offset) up to n times, then disarms and leaves the page writable. RECOMP_TEST_VTOL_VELWATCH=<n> arms it on comp+0x50 (body velocity x) of the first VTOL that carries a rider 10 m up; that is how the integrator sub_002AD940 was found as the writer.
